articles.title: India, Mexico begin talks for trade pact; aim to boost commerce, investments
articles.desc: India and Mexico have initiated negotiations for a preferential trade agreement to enhance bilateral trade and investment. The agreement aims to create new economic opportunities while addressing market access, customs procedures, and trade facilitation. Discussions included organising a Mexican business mission to India in early 2027 to improve commercial ties. India had a trade surplus with Mexico, largely due to exports in autos and pharmaceuticals.

articles.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 profit falls 24% despite record sales
articles.desc: Hyundai Motor India’s Q2 FY27 net profit fell 24% to Rs 1,196.2 crore as commodity costs pressured margins. Revenue rose 19% to Rs 20,696.1 crore, supported by record sales, stronger exports and upcoming vehicle launches.

articles.title: Israeli stocks fall, shekel weakens as Netanyahu bloc beats election forecasts
articles.desc: Israel's election results indicate Prime Minister Netanyahu's right-wing bloc is projected to win 54 seats. While the opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot is expected to secure 47 seats, neither group achieved a parliamentary majority. The shekel weakened significantly, and the Tel Aviv stock index fell following the surprising election results. Analysts predict a challenging path ahead for forming a stable government in Israel.

articles.title: Anant Raj Q2 Results: Profit rises 13% to Rs 156 crore
articles.desc: Anant Raj Ltd has demonstrated robust financial performance, with a 13 percent rise in consolidated net profits for the September quarter. The company's total income surged to Rs 678.95 crore, up from Rs 640.89 crore the previous year. For the first half of the year, net profit climbed to Rs 305.68 crore, compared to Rs 264.08 crore, signaling its strong standing in the Indian real estate sector.

articles.title: Vedanta Aluminium quarterly profit more than doubles on high prices, record production
articles.desc: Vedanta Aluminium reported a significant increase in its quarterly profit, which more than doubled from the previous year. The company's consolidated net profit rose to 51.67 billion rupees for the quarter ending September 30. Revenue from operations also increased by 40% during the same period, driven by elevated aluminium prices. Aluminium production hit a record of 649,000 metric tons, up 5% from last year.

articles.title: Cholamandalam Investment Q2 Results: Profit surges 41% to Rs 1,630 crore; co plans to raise Rs 5,00O crore via QIP
articles.desc: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company has reported an impressive 41 percent surge in net profit for the second quarter, marking Rs 1,630 crore, up from Rs 1,155 crore the previous year. Their total income significantly increased to Rs 9,367 crore, primarily fueled by rising interest income. Additionally, the company's gross non-performing assets improved to 3.29 percent, signaling enhanced asset quality.

articles.title: TVS Motor Q2 Results: Profit jumps 52% YoY to Rs 1,377 crore; revenue rises 44%
articles.desc: TVS Motor Company reported a 52% rise in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 1,377 crore, with revenue up 44%. Record sales, electric two-wheeler growth and strategic acquisitions boosted performance, while shares gained 2.52% on the NSE.

articles.title: Jio debuts on D-Street: India’s biggest IPOs delivered negative returns over one month after listing. Will Jio break the curse?
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has marked a significant milestone by successfully launching its market debut following India’s largest initial public offering, valued at Rs 30,213-crore. articles.desc: Meta has launched a "tamagotchi-style" pet game called Waddle World, with virtual creatures that chat with users and create doodles to illustrate conversations. articles.title: From 104 shareholders to nearly 80 lakh! Jio becomes India's most widely owned stock on listing day
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has become India’s most widely held listed stock, with 79.6 lakh shareholders following its blockbuster IPO, overtaking Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Reliance Industries and Vodafone Idea. From just 104 shareholders before the issue, Jio attracted over 1.38 crore applications and debuted at a market capitalisation of Rs 12.53 lakh crore.

articles.title: Centre open to changes in DPDP law to  protect press freedom, says Ashwini Vaishnaw
articles.desc: The Centre aims to amend the Digital Personal Data Protection law to address concerns raised by news publishers. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the law does not limit press freedom. This response follows a Supreme Court notice regarding a petition from the Digital News Publishers Association and others. Publishers argue the lack of exemption for journalism could jeopardize investigative reporting and confidential sources.

articles.title: Burnham’s government unveils its first UK budget: What to expect
articles.desc: UK chancellor to present an autumn budget amid rising living costs and energy bills.

articles.title: MFs raise stake for 3 straight quarters in 5 mid-cap stocks; shares gain up to 75% YTD
articles.desc: Mutual funds steadily increased their holdings in 39 BSE midcap stocks for three consecutive quarters through September 2026. While five stocks gained 15–75% in CY26, several others declined sharply despite continued institutional buying.

articles.title: India's industrial growth slows to 6.7% in September from 8% in August
articles.desc: India's Index of Industrial Production for September recorded a growth rate of 6.7%. This figure represents a decline from August's 8%. Key contributors to this growth include the manufacture of motor vehicles and electrical equipment, among others. The manufacture of rubber and plastics also played a significant role in September's performance. These statistics were released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

articles.title: Info Edge Q2 Results: Net profit plunges 93% YoY to Rs 334 crore, revenue rises 13%; co declares Rs 3/share interim dividend
articles.desc: Info Edge reported a sharp year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit due to a large exceptional gain in the previous year, while revenue and operating profit grew. Recruitment, 99acres and matchmaking businesses recorded healthy growth, alongside AI-led expansion.

articles.desc: As the Russia-Africa Summit gets under way, students in the capital say education is helping to build ties.

articles.title: Global Market: Nomura Holdings Q2 profit rises 13% on wealth management growth
articles.desc: Nomura Holdings reported a 13% YoY rise in second-quarter net profit to 103.7 billion yen, supported by strong wholesale earnings and steady wealth management growth. Its wholesale income jumped 47% amid robust trading and investment banking activity.

articles.title: Global Market: European shares waver as earnings, rising oil weigh on sentiment
articles.desc: European shares edged lower as investors assessed mixed bank earnings and rising oil prices ahead of the European Central Bank’s policy decision. Technology and energy stocks gained, offering some support amid broader market weakness.

articles.desc: The two Nordic leaders are attempting to influence US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi to end the war in Ukraine.

articles.desc: The Indian rupee closed lower against the dollar as oil prices surged due to supply concerns. Brent oil rose to $115.3 per barrel following recent events in Saudi Arabia. Iranian mediators proposed a new draft to resolve ongoing conflicts, with expectations for Tehran's response by week's end. Traders remain increasingly bearish on the rupee amid uncertainty in oil markets and economic implications.

articles.title: Cabinet hikes Dearness Allowance by 3% with Rs 10,000 crore allocation; check key announcements
articles.desc: DA hike: The Union Cabinet has approved several development schemes totaling Rs 29,267 crores for various initiatives. Among these is a Rs 10,016 crore increase in Dearness Allowance for Central government employees. The DA will benefit about 48 lakh employees and 68 lakh pensioners, with hikes effective from July 1, 2026.

articles.title: Diwali 2026: Sensex plunged 10,000 points, Nifty dropped 12% since last Diwali. Will Samvat 2083 bring some relief?
articles.desc: Dalal Street heads into Samvat 2083 after a turbulent year that saw the Sensex plunge over 10,750 points and the Nifty shed nearly 12% since last Diwali. The Iran-US conflict, elevated crude oil prices, persistent FII outflows and AI-led IT selloff weighed on sentiment. Can easing headwinds revive the market?

articles.title: Energy bill help, minimum wage rise and bank taxes - what could be in the Budget?
articles.desc: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

articles.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 Results: Standalone profit falls 24% YoY to Rs 1,189 crore, but revenue rises 18%
articles.desc: Hyundai Motors India has reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,189 crore for Q2 FY27, reflecting a notable decrease of 24% compared to Rs 1,570 crore during the same period last year. However, their operational revenue has grown to Rs 20,191 crore, representing an 18% increase from Rs 17,061 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. This performance illustrates the company's resilience amidst shifting market conditions.

articles.title: From Dhirubhai Ambani’s Rs 10 crore IPO to Akash Ambani’s Rs 12.5 lakh crore Jio debut: Reliance’s biggest wealth story

articles.title: Vedanta Q2 Results: Profit zooms 78% YoY to Rs 6,202 crore; revenue surges 57%
articles.desc: Vedanta Q2 Results: Vedanta Ltd reported a 78% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 6,202 crore in the September quarter, while revenue increased 57% to Rs 26,356 crore. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 9,938 crore, with margins improving to 60%. Higher commodity prices and increased production supported earnings, while net debt fell by Rs 4,624 crore to Rs 3,675 crore during the quarter.

articles.title: Ambani bluechip bet gets bigger: Investors mark 82% of traded Jio shares for holding beyond listing
articles.desc: Jio Platforms saw nearly 82% of its traded volume marked for delivery on debut, with 10.66 crore shares carried into settlement out of 13.02 crore shares traded. The stock listed at a 21.36% premium to its IPO price, while Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Securities initiated coverage with Buy ratings.

articles.desc: The agreement aims to cut tariffs, reduce red tape and improve market access for businesses in both countries.

Conversely, operational revenue surged by 75%, hitting Rs 37,216 crore. This stark contrast is notable due to the previous year's inflated profits, driven by exceptional gains totaling Rs 3,583 crore, highlighting a dramatic shift in financial performance.

articles.title: Jio effect! Reliance beats Tata to become India's most valued conglomerate
articles.desc: Jio Platforms’ listing has propelled the Reliance Group to become India’s most valuable conglomerate, with a combined market capitalisation of over Rs 28 lakh crore, surpassing the Tata Group. articles.desc: Adani Green Energy Limited is looking forward to a decrease in leverage as its upcoming projects start functioning and yield cash flow. With a substantial ₹2.4 lakh crore earmarked for capital expenditures by FY30, the company aims to enhance its renewable energy capacity. As project loans are paid off, leverage is expected to dip below four times.

articles.desc: BNP Paribas reported a 14% year-on-year rise in third-quarter net income to €3.46 billion, beating analyst estimates as record equity trading revenue boosted investment banking. The French lender also announced a €1.3 billion share buyback.

articles.title: Global Market: China's yuan holds near four-year high as markets await Fed decision
articles.desc: China’s yuan held near a four-year high against the US dollar as investors awaited the Federal Reserve’s policy decision for clues on the US interest rate outlook. The currency drew support from stronger-than-expected industrial profit growth, while concerns over persistent inflation and elevated energy prices kept markets alert to potential monetary tightening.

With consumer prices accelerating and affordability under pressure, investors will watch Chair Kevin Warsh’s comments for clues on the December rate decision and the outlook for further monetary tightening.

articles.title: India's soybean imports surge to record as domestic prices rally
articles.desc: India's soybean imports significantly increased to 1.1 million metric tons in 2025/26 compared to the previous year. Rising domestic prices prompted Indian mills to enhance their overseas purchases of soybeans. The majority of these imports originated from Niger, which became the largest exporter to India.

articles.title: China's CXMT to start advanced AI memory production despite poor yields
articles.desc: The decision highlights China's intense shortage of the AI memory chips, which are essential to a government-backed push to develop domestic alternatives to Nvidia's AI processors at scale amid US curbs on access to foreign-made technology.

articles.title: Infosys, TechM, TCS, other IT stocks plunge up to 5%, extend losses as global AI trade rebounds. What lies ahead?
articles.desc: Indian IT stocks fell sharply on Wednsday as renewed optimism around the global AI trade weighed on sentiment. Strong earnings from SK Hynix and Anthropic’s IPO filing fuelled gains in AI-linked stocks globally. However, concerns over an AI bubble persist, with analysts highlighting a potential advantage for Indian IT services firms.

articles.title: TPG pursues $5 billion acquisition of British data centre group Ark: FT
articles.desc: Global alternative asset manager TPG is in talks to buy British data centre group Ark from Elliott Investment Management at a valuation of about $5 billion, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Can the AI boom sustain SK Hynix's record earnings?
articles.desc: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported record quarterly earnings as booming demand for artificial intelligence memory chips boosted revenue and profitability.

articles.title: Weak domestic returns fuel India's overseas retail investing boom
articles.desc: Indian investors are turning to global funds as domestic market performance remains weak and opportunities abroad increase. A surge in overseas investments, particularly in AI-related assets, has been noted recently. Fund managers are launching various international funds to cater to this growing demand. Regulatory limits on overseas investments are in place, but tax-neutral hubs offer solutions.

articles.title: Global Market: Japan bond yields rise as investors eye BOJ policy meeting
articles.desc: Japanese government bond yields rise as an AI-led equity rebound weakens safe-haven demand. Investors await the BOJ’s policy decision and guidance on future rate hikes amid persistent inflation, fiscal uncertainty and concerns over government borrowing.

articles.title: Maruti Suzuki shares see target price cuts by Jefferies, Nomura, other brokerages after Q2 net profit drops 26% YoY. What’s ahead?
articles.desc: Maruti Suzuki shares post marginal gains despite a 26% YoY decline in Q2 FY27 net profit. Jefferies, Nomura and Elara Capital lower their target prices, citing weaker margins and financial income, even as record sales volumes and strong revenue growth offer support.

articles.title: GST clarification on foreign investor brokerage offers sentiment boost, analysts say
articles.desc: The Indian government has clarified that brokerage paid by overseas clients may qualify as an export service. This could help foreign investors avoid the 18% goods and services tax on brokerage fees. Analysts suggest this clarification is sentimentally positive amid significant foreign outflows from Indian stocks. There is ongoing speculation regarding potential cuts in capital gains tax ahead of the federal budget.

articles.title: TCS, Vedanta among 10 companies offering dividend yield of up to 7%. Do you own any?
articles.desc: Currently, numerous companies are enticing income-focused investors with impressive dividend yields. Notably, Vedanta and Coal India shine with a hefty 7% dividend yield. In comparison, Indian Oil Corporation and Bharat Petroleum offer more modest yields at 6%. Conversely, Tata Consultancy Services and HCL Technologies yield at around 4%, targeting distinct investor preferences. These firms highlight the significance of consistent dividend income for shareholders.

articles.title: Subros shares surge 10% after securing Rs 1,225 crore HVAC supply order from Maruti Suzuki
articles.desc: Subros shares surged up to 10% after securing a Rs 1,225 crore HVAC supply contract from Maruti Suzuki for two vehicle models over approximately seven years. The award comes as the stock remains down around 45% over the past year.

articles.title: 'Fully subscribed in 95 minutes’: Jio listing leaves with greater responsibility, says Akash Ambani
Isha Ambani says Jio IPO marks a promise, renews Dhirubhai Ambani’s trust with investors
articles.desc: Isha Ambani described Jio Platforms’ stock market debut as a promise to honour the trust of investors and customers, nearly five decades after Dhirubhai Ambani took Reliance Industries public. Jio’s Rs 30,200-crore IPO attracted over Rs 7 lakh crore in demand, with the stock listing at a 21.3% premium.

articles.title: Smallcap stocks rally up to 21% in 2 days: Should you chase the rush or book profits?
articles.desc: In the last two trading sessions, smallcap stocks have experienced an impressive resurgence, with certain stocks posting significant gains. As investors weigh their options, they face the decision of whether to capitalize on this upswing or secure profits amidst growing caution. Technical analysts identify critical resistance levels, foreseeing possible pullbacks. They recommend partial profit-taking at these points while also highlighting several stocks with promising recovery signs for potential purchases.

articles.title: Global Market: Japan’s Nikkei jumps over 1% as tech rally on Wall Street lifts sentiment
articles.desc: Japan’s Nikkei rose 1.34%, tracking Wall Street’s technology-led rally, as semiconductor stocks gained. Investors remain cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision, corporate earnings and geopolitical developments.

articles.title: Indian IT firms poised to benefit from enterprise AI adoption as infrastructure costs rise: Report
articles.desc: Indian information technology (IT) companies are well-positioned to benefit from the growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by enterprises, as rising infrastructure investments and funding requirements increase financial risks for companies building and operating AI computing capacity, according to a research report by Anand Rathi.

articles.title: United Breweries shares rally 14% after Q2FY27 profit jumps 191% YoY
articles.desc: United Breweries shares surged by 14.44% as the company announced a staggering 191% jump in net profit, now at Rs 135 crore for the September quarter of FY27. Additionally, net sales increased by 24% to reach Rs 2,537 crore, driven by strong premium beer sales. However, despite this impressive performance, the stock has seen a decline of about 30% over the previous year.

articles.title: No. 2 on Day 1: How Jio Platforms broke India’s market cap hierarchy in debut trade
articles.desc: Jio Platforms made a blockbuster stock market debut, listing at a 21.3% premium over its IPO price of Rs 1,119 at Rs 1,358 on the BSE. With a market capitalisation of around Rs 12.5 lakh crore, it became India’s second-most valuable listed company after parent Reliance Industries, overtaking Bharti Airtel. The debut also made Jio India’s largest listed telecom company, placing it ahead of major players such as TCS, SBI and Bajaj Finance.

articles.title: ‘Jio Mere Laal’: Anant Ambani’s emotional words leave Mukesh Ambani teary-eyed

However, weak consumption and disappointing results from liquor maker Wuliangye continued to weigh on sentiment.

articles.title: India bonds sink on oil spike before Fed decision
articles.desc: Indian government bonds experienced a significant decline after a prior rally due to rising oil prices. Brent crude oil prices increased following concerns over supply disruptions in Saudi Arabia. The US 10-year Treasury yield also rose, affecting the attractiveness of Indian debt. Markets are anticipating the Federal Reserve's policy decision and rate outlook, impacting investor sentiment.

articles.title: Gold, silver prices crash up to 53% from January peak. Time to buy before Dhanteras, festive season?
articles.desc: Gold and silver prices have corrected sharply from their January peaks, raising questions about whether the fall offers a buying opportunity ahead of Dhanteras and the wedding season. Experts recommend staggered purchases over lump-sum investments, while highlighting interest rates, the US dollar, inflation and industrial demand as key drivers of prices.

articles.title: India, Mexico sign terms of reference to kickstart trade pact negotiations
articles.desc: India and Mexico have signed the Terms of Reference to initiate negotiations on a Preferential Trade Agreement. This agreement aims to enhance bilateral trade and investment opportunities between the two countries. Key negotiating areas include market access, customs procedures, and trade facilitation measures. Both delegations discussed organizing a Mexican business mission to India in early 2027.

articles.title: Jio Platforms shares get 3 Buy calls on Day 1 as Nomura, Motilal and Elara initiate coverage. Check target price
articles.desc: Jio Platforms debuted at a 21.36% premium to its IPO price on Wednesday, while Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Capital initiated coverage with Buy ratings. Brokerages cited telecom leadership, tariff hikes, rising ARPU, digital services and improving cash flow as key growth drivers.

articles.title: L&T shares rally 6% after Q2 net profit jumps 33% YoY. Why Jefferies cut target price?
articles.desc: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) shares rose sharply on Wednesday after the company reported a 33% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,202 crore. Jefferies retained its Buy rating but cut the target price to Rs 4,700, citing weaker-than-expected margins and factoring in lower estimates.

articles.title: AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%
articles.desc: South Korean chip giant SK hynix said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit soared 632 percent on-year, largely driven by the artificial intelligence industry's explosive demand for its advanced memory chips. The memory chip giant said it had posted record revenue and operating profit for six straight quarters since the second quarter of last year.

articles.title: Oracle's Larry Ellison dismisses 'SaaS apocalypse' fears, says AI will make software better
articles.desc: Speaking at Oracle AI World here, Ellison, the company's executive chairman and chief technology officer, rejected talk of a "SaaS apocalypse", in which businesses would use AI to build their own applications instead of buying software-as-a-service (SaaS) products.

articles.title: India among Oracle NetSuite's highest-priority markets, says Asia head Amit Suxena
articles.desc: Speaking to PTI on the sidelines of Oracle AI World, Amit Suxena, group vice president and head of Asia at Oracle NetSuite, an AI-native business management platform, said momentum among Indian businesses had been growing over the last four to five years.

articles.title: US agency approves Amazon Leo's $11.5 billion acquisition of Globalstar
articles.desc: The Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday it has approved Amazon Leo's $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar as the retail giant's satellite arm aims to build a satellite-based communications network to take on Elon Musk's SpaceX Starlink unit.

articles.title: Nearly 60% of firms yet to move AI beyond pilots as deployment remains key challenge: Report
articles.desc: Nearly 60 per cent of organisations surveyed remain in the exploration or pilot stages of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, with only around 40 per cent having moved to production or scaling, highlighting the challenge businesses face in deploying AI across their operations, according to a report by Citi Institute.

articles.title: Meta, Snap head to trial in another case about social media's harms
articles.desc: Jury selection is expected to begin on Wednesday in Los Angeles for another landmark trial about the alleged harms of social media on young users, with Meta and, for the first time, Snap as defendants. Meta and YouTube lost the first so-called bellwether case earlier this year, when a jury found them collectively liable for harming a young user known by the initials KGM, and ordered the tech companies to pay a combined $6 million penalty.

articles.title: India, Azerbaijan move to reset ties, boost energy investments and connectivity
articles.desc: Delhi and Baku are currently taking steps to improve bilateral relations through enhanced economic cooperation and connectivity initiatives. After a positive meeting, the Foreign Ministers of both nations emphasized the importance of the International North-South Transport Corridor. There has been a notable increase in Indian investment in Azerbaijan's energy sector, with cumulative investments reaching $1.26 billion. Additionally, both countries are working to strengthen security cooperation against transnational crime.

articles.title: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips
articles.desc: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, The Information reported on Tuesday, citing a person familiar with the matter, as technology companies ramp up spending on data centers and semiconductors to meet surging demand for AI computing.

articles.title: US agency is again probing if Polymarket broke 2022 settlement, sources says
articles.desc: A US regulator is investigating whether prediction market operator Polymarket violated a 2022 enforcement deal in which it promised to ban US users from its main overseas platform, reviving an inquiry the agency shuttered last year without bringing

articles.title: India’s record bank cash surplus fades as RBI curbs rupee bets
articles.desc: Indian banks have seen their excess funds drop significantly as the Reserve Bank of India maintains liquidity tightness. This monetary policy is aimed at curbing speculation against the rupee, which has reached critical levels. The central bank has provided limited liquidity support and capped assistance at 1.5 trillion rupees. Consequently, overnight borrowing rates have risen close to the top of the monetary policy range.

articles.title: Cognizant eyes Sarvam stake; Ather aims for higher market share
articles.desc: Happy Wednesday! Cognizant has held discussions to invest in homegrown AI startup Sarvam. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

articles.title: What we know about Ukraine-Russia truce in Oleshky, brokered by Melania Trump
articles.desc: The Russian-occupied city of Oleshky has had no electricity, gas or water for three years, as residents reported having to eat weeds to survive.

articles.title: India in striking distance of 8% growth as reforms boost economy: Shaktikanta Das
articles.desc: Das said the BFSI sector has a crucial role to play in India's journey from a lower-middle-income economy to a high-income economy, through its intermediation in allocation of financial resources. He said the sector would be required to support India's next-gen Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), be the frontline of green and transition finance and become the catalyst for democratising financial inclusion to support this journey.

articles.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
articles.desc: An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Finland's President Alexander Stubb said.

articles.title: GST registration gets easier as CBIC drops Udyam proof, sets seven-day limit for approvals
articles.desc: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs has issued clarifications regarding GST registration requirements for businesses. Companies will no longer need to provide Udyam certificates or face rejections due to unpaid bills. Registration applications must be processed within seven working days with Aadhaar authentication. Tax demands must include clear justifications and cannot be arbitrary. These changes aim to simplify compliance and reduce disputes in tax administration.

articles.title: Centre eases GST rules for post-sales discounts, no prior agreement needed from November 1
articles.desc: The Centre eases GST rules on post-sales discounts from November 1, no longer requiring a prior agreement, which is expected to help FMCG and pharma companies and retailers.

articles.title: India to emerge as major exporter to China, ASEAN, get edge in US trade pact, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal highlighted India's potential to expand exports to China and ASEAN. Negotiations are underway for a trade pact with the United States that could provide India a comparative advantage. The country is also working towards an Investment Protection Agreement with the European Union. Goyal indicated that discussions for preferential trade agreements are progressing with multiple countries and groups.

articles.desc: The government had relaxed FDI restrictions imposed under Press Note 3 for countries sharing land borders with India, such as China and Pakistan, through Press Note 2 in March.

articles.desc: When attorneys general from across the US announced a $17 billion settlement with Meta this summer, the sum was unprecedented. articles.title: Russia’s farm exports to India rise 11% in nine months, led by sunflower oil
articles.desc: Russia's agricultural exports to India rose significantly in the first nine months of the year. Agroexport reported shipments reached 1.3 million tons, primarily driven by sunflower oil. This represents an 11% increase in volume compared to previous figures, amounting to $1.45 billion. Trade between India and Russia has expanded significantly, growing more than 20% overall this year. Both countries aim for $100 billion in bilateral trade by 2030.

articles.title: Swiss AI drug trial startup receives funding from Spotify-backer Creandum
articles.desc: An AI foundation model, trained on about two million human RNA readouts, would replace these and animal testing with 12-week simulations, the company said.

articles.title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urges states to ensure quality spending, prudent borrowing
articles.desc: Addressing the 36th conference of state finance secretaries at the Mint Road, Malhotra appealed the states to onboard onto the Unified Lending Interface (ULI) and utilise Programmable Central Bank Digital Currency (P-CBDC) for Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT).

articles.title: India considers measures to boost local production of 100 critical inputs to cut import reliance, government official says
articles.desc: India is taking steps to encourage the local manufacturing of 100 key items that are currently imported. This initiative aims to decrease dependence on foreign suppliers, especially from China, to enhance domestic production capabilities. The government has identified these crucial items from a broader import list valued at $51 billion, which includes various sectors. By reducing reliance on imports, India hopes to strengthen its economy and mitigate supply chain risks.
